nodes.label: POST /master/master-hierarchy (Create Material Hierarchy)
nodes.rationale: Creates material group items keyed by material_group, extended_material_group, material_number and server, establishing the SAP-side classification that vendor and category assignment later hangs off.

nodes.label: GET /master/master-hierarchy (Material Hierarchy Pagination)
nodes.rationale: Unusually marks page, limit, search, sort_by and order as required:true, unlike the other master-data listings where the same parameters are optional.

nodes.label: DELETE /master/master-hierarchy (Soft Delete Material Hierarchy, deprecated)
nodes.rationale: Marked deprecated:true. Soft deletion of material group items is being retired in favour of the is_active flag carried on the create/update payloads, so referential history is preserved for existing RFQs.

edges.source_location: post/get on the same path item
put body is the post body plus id and is_active
deletes ids returned by the listing
